qualification.method: Qualification was performed in three batches. The first two use the five repaired driver patches. The final batch uses all seven patches and supersedes all modern UDP and negative reconnect results affected by the additional fixture/observation patches. Baseline and other additions use unchanged code paths; this is not represented as a single full run of the seven-patch build.
